notes: V3 + V25 + V8, pinned at the cards/integration merge (2026-10-30). Printed: '[-2]: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.' The ability has exactly two target slots, designated in order (V25: Blood Glutton, then the Giant; V8 validates each against its own slot). CR 120.2b: the first target deals the damage, so Blood Glutton's lifelink gains its controller 4 (CR 702.15b) and Garruk is not the source (V3's dealer role). Before V3 Garruk was the source and no life was gained.
